meaning.en: the wandering renunciate (this Upanishad)
the Trishikhi Brahmana Upanishad
the Sita Upanishad
the Yoga Chudamani Upanishad
the Nirvana and Mandala Brahmana Upanishads
the Dakshinamurti, Sharabha and Skanda Upanishads
the Mahanarayana and the Advaya Taraka
Narada, whose ornament is the wanderer's life
having reached clarity of mind
the Naimisha forest
the great sages led by Shaunaka
what is the means to liberation
complete in the forty-four sacraments
endowed with the four qualifications
in the order of the paramahamsa
he leaves the body and is liberated
meaning.hi: वह देह छोड़ता है और मुक्त होता है

meaning.en: one who renounces out of the desire to know
meaning.hi: जानने की इच्छा से संन्यास लेने वाला

meaning.en: having gone a hundred steps
stop, stop, fortunate one
take the staff, cloth and water pot
meaning.hi: दण्ड, वस्त्र और कमण्डलु ग्रहण करो

meaning.en: to receive Om and the great sayings
meaning.hi: ॐ और महावाक्य ग्रहण करने के लिए

meaning.en: a staff of bamboo
you are Indra's thunderbolt
anointed with the yoga band
I have done what had to be done
Narada asked the Grandfather
who is qualified for renunciation
listen attentively
the eunuch, the outcast, the disabled
one who teaches for a wage
are not fit to renounce
become qualified by instruction in the great sayings
attains fearlessness (gives and receives no fear)
he is the wanderer, says tradition
meaning.hi: वही परिव्राजक है, ऐसा स्मृति कहती है

meaning.en: the eunuch
the disabled, one lacking a limb
the blind
a child
one guilty of grave sin
the outcast
one who goes to others' wives
meaning.hi: पराई स्त्री के पास जाने वाला

meaning.en: the Vaikhanasa and the priest of Shiva
the discus-marked, the emblem-bearer and the heretic
one with a skin disease
one who keeps no sacred fire
one who has renounced two or three times
meaning.hi: जो दो-तीन बार संन्यास ले चुका

meaning.en: the paid teacher
these are not entitled to renounce
except in the deathbed form, not the regular sequence
meaning.hi: आतुर-संन्यास को छोड़कर, क्रम से नहीं

meaning.en: how is the emergency time accepted by the noble
meaning.hi: सज्जनों द्वारा आतुर-काल कैसे माना गया

meaning.en: the time when the breath is about to depart
meaning.hi: प्राण के निकलने के निकट का समय

meaning.en: is called the emergency
no other
that sets one on the path to liberation
even in the emergency renunciation
preceded by the respective mantras
and having repeated the mantras
the wise one should renounce according to rule
whether in the emergency or the regular order
meaning.hi: आतुर में हो या क्रम में

meaning.en: there is no difference anywhere in the declaration
meaning.hi: प्रैष में कहीं कोई भेद नहीं

meaning.en: no mantra is without its act
the act requires the mantra
meaning.hi: कर्म मन्त्र की अपेक्षा रखता है

meaning.en: an act without mantra is no act
therefore one should not abandon the mantra
if one does an act without the mantra
meaning.hi: यदि मन्त्र के बिना कर्म करे

meaning.en: it becomes like an offering poured on ashes
meaning.hi: वह राख में आहुति जैसा हो जाता है

meaning.en: as an abridgment of the prescribed rites
the emergency renunciation is understood
therefore in emergency renunciation
the rule is repetition of mantras, O sage
meaning.hi: हे मुनि, मन्त्र-आवृत्ति की विधि है

meaning.en: one who has established the sacred fires
meaning.hi: जिसने पवित्र अग्नियाँ स्थापित की हों

meaning.en: if he becomes free of desire
if he has gone to another land
the offering to Prajapati, in water itself
meaning.hi: प्रजापति की इष्टि, जल में ही

meaning.en: having completed it, he should then renounce
meaning.hi: उसे पूरा करके फिर संन्यास ले

meaning.en: either in the mind
or by repeating the prescribed mantras
meaning.hi: या विधि-विहित मन्त्रों की आवृत्ति से

meaning.en: in water
by the path of Vedic observance
or by the actual performance of the rite
meaning.hi: या कर्म का वास्तविक अनुष्ठान करके

meaning.en: having completed
the wise one should renounce
if not
he would incur the state of a fallen one
meaning.hi: वह पतित होने की दशा पाएगा

meaning.en: when there has arisen in the mind
meaning.hi: जब मन में उत्पन्न हो जाए

meaning.en: freedom from thirst for all things
meaning.hi: सब वस्तुओं के प्रति तृष्णा का अभाव

meaning.en: then one should seek renunciation
in the reverse case one would be fallen
meaning.hi: उलटा होने पर वह पतित होगा

meaning.en: the wise one free of passion should go forth
but the one with passion should live at home
the passionate one goes to hell
going forth, he is the lowest of the twice-born
meaning.hi: घर छोड़कर वह द्विजों में अधम है

meaning.en: one for whom these are well guarded
tongue, sexual organ, belly and hand
may renounce without having married
a Brahmin who keeps celibacy
seeing worldly life as without substance
with the wish to see the essence
meaning.hi: सार को देखने की इच्छा से

meaning.en: the unmarried go forth
resorting to the highest detachment
action is marked by outward engagement
knowledge is marked by renunciation
placing knowledge first
the intelligent one should renounce here
when the truth has been known
the supreme eternal Brahman
taking up a single staff
he should give up the tuft along with the sacred thread
who is devoted to the supreme Self
detached from what is not the supreme Self
meaning.hi: जो परमात्मा से भिन्न में विरक्त है

meaning.en: freed from all cravings
he is worthy to eat alms
worshipped and saluted
as he would be well pleased
so too if he is being beaten
then he becomes an eater of alms
I myself am the imperishable Brahman
the non-dual one called Vasudeva
one in whom this conviction is firm
then he is fit to eat alms
in whom are peace, calm and purity
meaning.hi: जिसमें शान्ति, शम और शौच हों

meaning.en: truthfulness, contentment and straightforwardness
owning nothing and free of hypocrisy
he may dwell in the order of absolute freedom
when he does not form an intention
harmful toward any being
meaning.hi: किसी भी प्राणी के प्रति बुरा

meaning.en: by deed, mind or speech
then he is fit to eat alms
the law with ten marks
practising it with a collected mind
meaning.hi: एकाग्र मन से उसका पालन करते हुए

meaning.en: having heard the Vedanta properly
the twice-born free of debts should renounce
fortitude, forbearance, self-control
not stealing, purity
restraint of the senses
judgement, knowledge
truth, freedom from anger
the tenfold mark of dharma
he does not recall past pleasures
meaning.hi: बीते भोगों को याद नहीं करता

meaning.en: nor likewise those yet to come
and does not rejoice in those obtained
meaning.hi: और प्राप्त का अभिनन्दन नहीं करता

meaning.en: he may live in the order of freedom
the inner faculties kept within
outer objects kept outside
one who can always do this
he may live in the order of freedom
just as the body, once breath has gone
feels neither pleasure nor pain
if likewise even while joined with breath
meaning.hi: यदि वैसे ही प्राण रहते हुए भी

meaning.en: he may live in the order of freedom
a pair of loincloths
a patched cloak
a single staff is his possession
meaning.hi: एक दण्ड ही उसका परिग्रह है

meaning.en: of the paramahamsa renunciate
nothing more is prescribed
if out of attachment he makes
meaning.hi: यदि राग से वह करता है

meaning.en: acquisition of more than this
having gone to the Raurava hell
he is born among animals
worn out yet clean
rags stitched together
making a patched cloak
he should wear an outer cloth dyed with ochre
meaning.hi: गेरू से रँगा ऊपरी वस्त्र पहने

meaning.en: with one cloth or without clothing
one-pointed in gaze and free of greed
he should always wander alone
in the rains he should stay in one place
meaning.hi: वर्षा में एक स्थान पर रहे

meaning.en: household, sons and wife
and the auxiliary Vedic sciences entirely
sacrifice and sacred thread
having given up, the ascetic should wander unnoticed
meaning.hi: छोड़कर संन्यासी गुप्त रूप से विचरे

meaning.en: desire, anger and arrogance
and greed, delusion and the like
meaning.hi: और लोभ, मोह आदि जो हैं

meaning.en: giving up those faults
the wanderer should be free of mine-ness
one whose self is free of attraction and aversion
to whom clod, stone and gold are equal
meaning.hi: जिसके लिए ढेला, पत्थर और सोना समान हैं

meaning.en: and who has turned away from harming creatures
the sage should be free of all longing
freed from hypocrisy and ego
avoiding violence and slander
endowed with the qualities of self-knowledge
the ascetic would attain liberation
through attachment of the senses
one incurs fault, without doubt
meaning.hi: निःसन्देह दोष को प्राप्त होता है

meaning.en: but restraining those very ones
he then attains perfection
desire never
is quenched by enjoying desired things
meaning.hi: भोगों के उपभोग से शान्त होती

meaning.en: like fire fed with oblation
it only grows more
meaning.hi: वह और अधिक बढ़ती ही है

meaning.en: having heard, touched and eaten
the man who has seen and smelled
neither exults nor droops
meaning.hi: न हर्षित होता है न ग्लानि पाता है

meaning.en: he should be known as master of his senses
one whose speech and mind are pure
meaning.hi: जिसकी वाणी और मन शुद्ध हों

meaning.en: and always well guarded
he indeed obtains all
meaning.hi: वह निश्चय ही सब पाता है

meaning.en: the fruit reached through Vedanta
meaning.hi: वेदान्त से प्राप्त होने वाला फल

meaning.en: from honour, the Brahmin always
should shrink as from poison
and should desire as if nectar
dishonour, always
the one disregarded sleeps at ease
and wakes at ease
he moves at ease in this world
meaning.hi: इस लोक में सुख से विचरता है

meaning.en: the one who scorns perishes
meaning.hi: अपमान करने वाला नष्ट होता है

meaning.en: he should endure abusive words
he should not despise anyone
and not relying on this body
meaning.hi: और इस देह का आश्रय लेकर नहीं

meaning.en: should he make enmity with anyone
he should not be angry at one who is angry
meaning.hi: क्रोध करने वाले पर क्रोध न करे

meaning.en: when abused, he should speak kindly
scattered through the seven gates
he should not speak false words
delighting in the Self, seated at ease
meaning.hi: आत्मा में रमा हुआ, स्थिर बैठा

meaning.en: without dependence and without wishes
with the Self alone as companion
seeking happiness, he should wander here
meaning.hi: सुख का अर्थी होकर यहाँ विचरे

meaning.en: by restraint of the senses
and by the wearing away of attraction and aversion
and by non-harming of beings
meaning.hi: और प्राणियों के प्रति अहिंसा से

meaning.en: one becomes fit for immortality
having bones for pillars
bound with sinews
plastered with flesh and blood
wrapped in skin, foul-smelling
full of urine and faeces
overtaken by old age and grief
a home of disease, afflicted
impure and impermanent
this dwelling of the elements he should give up
meaning.hi: पंचभूतों के इस निवास को त्याग दे

meaning.en: flesh, blood, pus, excrement, urine
in the compound of sinew, marrow and bone
meaning.hi: नस, मज्जा और हड्डी के ढेर में

meaning.en: if the deluded one is fond of the body
meaning.hi: यदि मूढ़ शरीर में प्रीति रखे

meaning.en: he would be so even in hell
meaning.hi: वह नरक में भी वैसा होगा

meaning.en: that is the road to Kalaputra
that is the net of the Mahavichi hell
that is the avenue of the sword-leaf forest
which is the stance 'I am the body'
meaning.hi: जो शरीर में मैं का भाव है

meaning.en: that must be given up with every effort
meaning.hi: उसे पूरे यत्न से त्यागना चाहिए

meaning.en: even when total ruin is at hand
the well-born should not touch it
meaning.hi: कुलीन को उसे नहीं छूना चाहिए

meaning.en: like an outcaste woman carrying dog's meat
meaning.hi: कुत्ते के मांस वाली अन्त्यज स्त्री की तरह

meaning.en: his good deeds to those dear to him
and his bad deeds to those not dear
releasing them, by the discipline of meditation
he enters the eternal Brahman
meaning.hi: सनातन ब्रह्म में प्रवेश करता है

meaning.en: by this method
giving up all attachments little by little
freed from all pairs of opposites
he abides in Brahman alone
meaning.hi: ब्रह्म में ही स्थित रहता है

meaning.en: he should always wander alone
for perfection, without a companion
meaning.hi: सिद्धि के लिए, बिना साथी के

meaning.en: seeing that perfection is of the solitary
he neither abandons nor is abandoned
meaning.hi: न छोड़ता है, न छोड़ा जाता है

meaning.en: a skull-bowl for begging
the roots of trees for shelter
poor clothes and no companion
meaning.hi: फटे वस्त्र और साथी का अभाव

meaning.en: and evenness toward everything
this is the mark of the liberated
devoted to the good of all beings, calm
meaning.hi: सब प्राणियों के हित में रत, शान्त

meaning.en: bearing the triple staff and water pot
delighting in the One, having wandered
he should enter a village for alms
meaning.hi: भिक्षा के लिए गाँव में प्रवेश करे

meaning.en: one mendicant is as prescribed
two are called a pair
meaning.hi: दो को जोड़ा कहा गया है

meaning.en: three are called a village
meaning.hi: तीन को गाँव कहा गया है

meaning.en: beyond that it becomes a city
meaning.hi: उससे अधिक नगर बन जाता है

meaning.en: a city must not be formed
nor a village, nor a pair
one who makes these three
the ascetic falls from his own duty
meaning.hi: यति अपने धर्म से गिरता है

meaning.en: among them there would be talk of kings and so on
meaning.hi: उनमें राजाओं आदि की बातें होंगी

meaning.en: talk of alms among each other
fondness, backbiting and envy
from proximity, without doubt
he should remain alone and without longing
he should not converse with anyone
he should give only 'Narayana'
as his reply, always, the ascetic
meaning.hi: संन्यासी सदा उत्तर के रूप में

meaning.en: alone, he should contemplate Brahman
with mind, speech, body and action
meaning.hi: मन, वाणी, शरीर और कर्म से

meaning.en: and he should not welcome death
meaning.hi: और मृत्यु का स्वागत न करे

meaning.en: nor life in any way
he should simply wait for the time
until his lifespan is completed
meaning.hi: जब तक आयु पूरी न हो

meaning.en: he should not rejoice in death
he should not rejoice in life
tongueless, sexless, lame
blind and deaf as well
and simple; the mendicant is freed
meaning.hi: और मुग्ध; भिक्षु मुक्त होता है

meaning.en: by these six, without doubt
'this is liked, this is not'
who even while eating does not cling
meaning.hi: जो खाते हुए भी आसक्त नहीं होता

meaning.en: speaks what is beneficial, true and measured
meaning.hi: हितकर, सत्य और मित बोलता है

meaning.en: him they call tongueless
just as a girl born today
so a woman of sixteen
and one of a hundred years, whoever seeing
meaning.hi: और सौ वर्ष की को जो देखकर

meaning.en: remains unmoved, he is the sexless one
one whose going about is for alms
meaning.hi: जिसका घूमना भिक्षा के लिए है

meaning.en: and for excretion
who goes no further than a yojana
meaning.hi: जो एक योजन से आगे नहीं जाता

meaning.en: he is in every way the lame one
whether standing or walking
whose eye does not go far
beyond the ground four yokes in length
meaning.hi: चार जुए भर भूमि को छोड़कर

meaning.en: that wanderer is called blind
helpful or harmful, pleasing
and words that bring grief
meaning.hi: और जो वचन शोक लाते हैं

meaning.en: though hearing, is as if not hearing
he is declared deaf
one who, in the presence of sense objects
though capable, as if with impaired senses
always behaves as if asleep
meaning.hi: सदा सोए हुए की तरह बर्ताव करता है

meaning.en: that mendicant is called simple
watching actors and such shows
gambling
and the company of a young woman
snacks, meals and a menstruating woman
these six he should never look at
meaning.hi: इन छह को कभी न देखे

meaning.en: attachment, hatred, pride, deceit
malice and delusion toward others
meaning.hi: दूसरों के प्रति द्रोह और मोह

meaning.en: these six the ascetic ever
should not think of even in mind
a cot and white clothes
and eagerness for talk of women
day-sleep and riding in vehicles
the six failings of ascetics
long journeys, with effort
the one contemplating the Self should avoid
always the knowledge of the Upanishads
he should practise, the cause of liberation
meaning.hi: मुक्ति का कारण, उसका अभ्यास करे

meaning.en: he should not constantly frequent holy places
the ascetic should not be devoted to fasting
nor be habitually given to study
nor be devoted to lecturing
conduct without sin or deceit
straight, he should always practise
gathering in the senses
as a tortoise its limbs, completely
meaning.hi: जैसे कछुआ अपने अंग, पूरी तरह

meaning.en: whose sense and mind activity has subsided
meaning.hi: जिसकी इन्द्रिय और मन की वृत्तियाँ क्षीण हैं

meaning.en: without wishes, without possessions
beyond opposites, bowing to none
and without ancestral offerings
without 'mine', without ego
without dependence, without desires
devoted to secluded places
he is freed; there is no doubt here
meaning.hi: मुक्त होता है, इसमें सन्देह नहीं

meaning.en: alert, endowed with action, devotion and knowledge
meaning.hi: सजग, कर्म, भक्ति और ज्ञान से सम्पन्न

meaning.en: completing studenthood, he should become a householder
he may go forth straight from studenthood
meaning.hi: सीधे ब्रह्मचर्य से ही संन्यास ले

words.sanskrit: yad ahar eva virajet tad ahar eva pravrajet

meaning.en: on the day he becomes detached, that day he should go forth
meaning.hi: जिस दिन विरक्त हो उसी दिन संन्यास ले

meaning.en: for fire is breath
he should perform the offering to the three elements
namely sattva, rajas and tamas
this is your timely source
he should inhale the fire

words.sanskrit: esha va agner yonir yah pranah

meaning.en: the source of fire is the breath
the waters are all the gods
giving up tuft and sacred thread
the knower of the Self goes forth
that is Brahman; that is to be worshipped
meaning.hi: वह ब्रह्म है; उसी की उपासना करनी है

meaning.en: Narada again asked the Grandfather
meaning.hi: नारद ने फिर पितामह से पूछा

meaning.en: how is one a Brahmin without the sacred thread
the Grandfather said to him
having shaved including the tuft
the wise should give up the outer thread
that which is the imperishable supreme Brahman
that he should wear as the thread
they call it sutra because it points out
meaning.hi: संकेत करने से इसे सूत्र कहते हैं

meaning.en: the thread is the supreme state
one by whom that thread is known
he is the sage who has crossed the Veda
that by which all this is strung
like clusters of gems on a thread
meaning.hi: धागे में मणियों के समूह की तरह

meaning.en: that thread the yogi should wear
meaning.hi: उस सूत्र को योगी धारण करे

meaning.en: the knower of yoga who sees the truth
the wise one should give up the outer thread
established in the highest yoga
this thread which is the state of Brahman
whoever wears it with awareness
he is neither polluted nor impure
meaning.hi: वह न जूठा होता है न अपवित्र

meaning.en: those whose thread has gone within
wearers of the sacred thread of knowledge
they indeed are the knowers of the thread in the world
meaning.hi: वे ही संसार में सूत्र-ज्ञाता हैं

meaning.en: and they are the thread-wearers
having knowledge as tuft, established in knowledge
meaning.hi: ज्ञान ही जिनकी शिखा, ज्ञान में स्थित

meaning.en: wearing knowledge as the sacred thread
for them knowledge alone is supreme
meaning.hi: उनके लिए ज्ञान ही परम है

meaning.en: knowledge is called the purifier
meaning.hi: ज्ञान को पवित्र कहा गया है

meaning.en: a tuft like the flame of fire, no other
meaning.hi: अग्नि की लौ जैसी शिखा, दूसरी नहीं

meaning.en: whose tuft is made of knowledge
that wise one is called tufted
the others are mere hair-wearers
but those who are entitled to rites
meaning.hi: पर जो कर्म के अधिकारी हैं

meaning.en: in Vedic ritual, Brahmins and others
by them this thread is to be worn
meaning.hi: उन्हें यह सूत्र धारण करना चाहिए

meaning.en: for it is known as a limb of the rite
meaning.hi: क्योंकि वह क्रिया का अंग माना गया है

meaning.en: whose tuft is made of knowledge
and whose thread is made of the same
meaning.hi: और जिसका उपवीत भी वैसा ही है

meaning.en: his Brahminhood is complete
so the knowers of Brahman know
with one cloth, shaven, without possessions
becoming naked as at birth
meaning.hi: जन्म के रूप जैसा नग्न होकर

meaning.en: free of the six waves
regarding his body as a corpse
meaning.hi: अपने शरीर को शव जैसा मानकर

meaning.en: content with what comes by chance
with no visible sign, no visible conduct
meaning.hi: अव्यक्त चिह्न और अव्यक्त आचरण वाला

meaning.en: giving up into the water with 'bhuh svaha'
meaning.hi: भूः स्वाहा कहकर जल में त्यागकर

meaning.en: I am that Brahman
by the maxim of the wasp and the grub
he has done all that was to be done
having given up the worlds and the Vedas
the sense objects and the senses
but whoever is established in the Self alone
meaning.hi: पर जो केवल आत्मा में स्थित है

meaning.en: he goes to the supreme goal
meaning.hi: वह परम गति को जाता है

meaning.en: name, clan and the like
country, time, learning, family
age, conduct, vow, character
the true ascetic should never proclaim
meaning.hi: सच्चा यति कभी प्रकट न करे

meaning.en: he should not converse with any woman
meaning.hi: किसी स्त्री से बात न करे

meaning.en: nor remember one seen before
meaning.hi: न पहले देखी को याद करे

meaning.en: and avoid talk about them
nor look even at a picture
these four, through delusion
of an ascetic engaging in them regarding women
meaning.hi: स्त्रियों के प्रति आचरण करने वाले यति का

meaning.en: the mind is certainly disturbed
through that disturbance he is ruined
meaning.hi: उस विकार से वह नष्ट होता है

meaning.en: craving, anger, untruth, deceit
greed and delusion, liked and disliked
meaning.hi: लोभ और मोह, प्रिय और अप्रिय

meaning.en: a craft and the business of lecturing
lust, attachment and possessions
ego and possessiveness
medical practice and rashness in religion
expiatory rites and dwelling abroad
spells, herbs, poisons and blessings
and these are forbidden
one who indulges in them goes down
meaning.hi: इनका सेवन करने वाला नीचे जाता है

meaning.en: 'come', 'go', 'stay'
welcome, even to a friend
and he should not speak words of honour
meaning.hi: और सम्मान के वचन न बोले

meaning.en: the sage devoted to liberation
he should not accept gifts
nor cause another to give
nor should the mendicant urge by it
never, even in a dream
of wife, brothers, sons and others
and the good and bad of relatives
hearing or seeing, he should not tremble
the ascetic should give up grief and joy
non-violence, truth, non-stealing
celibacy and non-possession
freedom from arrogance and from wretchedness
serenity, steadiness, straightness
no clinging, service to the teacher
faith, patience, restraint, calm
equanimity, fortitude, gentleness
endurance and compassion
modesty, knowledge and realisation
yoga, light eating, resolve
this is known as the proper duty
of self-controlled ascetics
beyond opposites, always in clarity
seeing equally everywhere
the fourth, the supreme swan
the ascetic is Narayana himself
he should stay one night in a village
five nights in a town
apart from the rainy season
in the rains he may stay four months
or he may stay two nights in a village
meaning.hi: या गाँव में दो रात रहे

meaning.en: if the mendicant stays on then
attachment and the rest would cling
by that he would be bound for hell
at the village edge, in a solitary place
meaning.hi: गाँव के छोर पर, निर्जन स्थान में

meaning.en: self-controlled, without a home
he should roam the earth like a small creature
meaning.hi: कीट की तरह धरती पर विचरे

meaning.en: in the rains he should stay in one place
meaning.hi: वर्षा में एक स्थान पर रहे

meaning.en: with one cloth or none
one-pointed in gaze, without greed
not defiling the path of the good
meaning.hi: सज्जनों के मार्ग को दूषित न करते हुए

meaning.en: absorbed in meditation, he should roam the earth
the mendicant always in a clean place
keeping his own duty
meaning.hi: अपने धर्म का पालन करता हुआ

meaning.en: the yogi should always wander
looking at the surface of the earth
not at night nor at midday
meaning.hi: न रात में, न दोपहर में

meaning.en: nor wandering at the twilights

words.sanskrit: na shunye na cha durge va

meaning.en: not in a deserted place nor a hard-to-reach one
meaning.hi: न सूने में, न दुर्गम में

meaning.en: nor where creatures would be harmed
meaning.hi: न जहाँ जीवों को कष्ट हो

meaning.en: one night he should stay in a village
but three days in a market town
the mendicant two days in a town
five nights in a city
in the rains he should stay in one place
in a place surrounded by holy water
meaning.hi: पवित्र जल से घिरे स्थान में

meaning.en: all beings as oneself
seeing, the mendicant should roam the earth
meaning.hi: देखता हुआ भिक्षु पृथ्वी पर विचरे

meaning.en: like a blind man and like a dull one
meaning.hi: अन्धे की तरह और जड़ की तरह

meaning.en: like the deaf, the mad and the mute
meaning.hi: बहरे, पागल और गूँगे की तरह

meaning.en: bathing three times a day is prescribed
for the Bahudaka and the forest-dweller
for the Hamsa, once only
meaning.hi: हंस के लिए एक बार ही

meaning.en: for the Paramahamsa there is none
silence, the yogic seat, yoga
endurance, a disposition for solitude
freedom from craving and evenness
these seven belong to the single-staffed
for one in the Paramahamsa order
meaning.hi: परमहंस आश्रम में स्थित के लिए

meaning.en: since bathing and the like are not prescribed
meaning.hi: स्नान आदि विहित न होने से

meaning.en: of all the movements of the mind without remainder
he should practise only the giving up
skin, flesh, blood, sinew
in the compound of marrow, fat and bone
meaning.hi: मज्जा, चर्बी और हड्डी के समूह में

meaning.en: of those delighting in faeces, urine and pus
meaning.hi: मल, मूत्र और पीब में रमने वालों का

meaning.en: how much difference from worms
where is the body, of all
a great heap of phlegm and the rest
and where beauty of limbs and charm
meaning.hi: और कहाँ अंगों की शोभा और सौभाग्य

meaning.en: loveliness and such qualities
flesh, blood, pus, dung, urine
in the bundle of sinew, marrow and bone
meaning.hi: नस, मज्जा और हड्डी की गठरी में

meaning.en: if the fool is fond of the body
meaning.hi: यदि मूढ़ देह से प्रेम करे

meaning.en: he would be so even in hell
meaning.hi: वह नरक में भी वैसा होगा

meaning.en: of the unmentionable part of women
and of a moist running sore
though there is no difference, through the mind's distinction
meaning.hi: अभेद होने पर भी मन के भेद से

meaning.en: people are mostly deceived
a piece of skin split in two
meaning.hi: दो में फटा चमड़ी का टुकड़ा

meaning.en: fumigated by the downward wind
to those who delight in it, salutations
meaning.hi: जो इसमें रमते हैं, उन्हें नमस्कार

meaning.en: what greater recklessness than this
for him there is no duty left
nor any outward mark for the wise one
meaning.hi: न विद्वान के लिए कोई चिह्न

meaning.en: free of 'mine', fearless, at peace
beyond opposites, eating without regard to caste
meaning.hi: द्वन्द्व-रहित, जाति-विचार बिना भोजन करने वाला

meaning.en: the sage may wear a loincloth
or be naked, intent on meditation
thus the yogi devoted to knowledge
becomes fit for becoming Brahman
meaning.hi: ब्रह्म होने के योग्य होता है

meaning.en: even when a mark is present, here
knowledge alone is the cause
for the liberation of beings here
meaning.hi: यहाँ प्राणियों की मुक्ति के लिए

meaning.en: a heap of marks is useless
whom neither as good nor as not good
neither unlearned nor very learned
neither of good nor of bad conduct
anyone knows, he is a Brahmin
meaning.hi: कोई जानता है, वह ब्राह्मण है

meaning.en: therefore, markless, knowing dharma
following the conduct of Brahman faithfully
the wise one resting on hidden dharma
should live with the conduct of the ignorant
ambiguous to all beings
free of caste and life-stage
like the blind and like the dull
and like the mute he should roam the earth
meaning.hi: और गूँगे की तरह पृथ्वी पर विचरे

meaning.en: seeing him of peaceful mind
the dwellers of heaven long for it
freedom comes from the absence of marks
thus is Brahma's instruction
tell us the procedure of renunciation
whether in emergency or in regular order
for taking up the fourth stage of life
meaning.hi: चौथे आश्रम को स्वीकार करने के लिए

meaning.en: preceded by the Krichchhra penance
he should perform the eight memorial offerings
gods, sages, celestials, humans, elements, ancestors, mothers, self
meaning.hi: देव, ऋषि, दिव्य, मनुष्य, भूत, पितर, माता, आत्मा

meaning.en: he should have hair, beard and nails cut
keeping seven hairs
having repeated the Gayatri a thousand times
having closed his own Vedic branch
sitting on a black antelope skin
sixteen oblations with the Purusha hymn
having performed the Viraja offering
may the Maruts sprinkle me
and Indra, and Brihaspati

words.sanskrit: ayusha cha dhanena cha balena cha

meaning.en: with life, wealth and strength
that sacrificial body of yours, O Agni
ascend, as self, into the self
having become the sacrifice, sit in the sacrifice
your own source, O Jatavedas
making the fire ascend into the self
meaning.hi: अग्नि को आत्मा में आरोपित करके

meaning.en: circling, bowing and dismissing it
sitting in navel-deep water
making the Savitri enter the sacred utterances
meaning.hi: सावित्री को व्याहृतियों में प्रवेश कराकर

meaning.en: I am the shaker of the tree
my fame is like a mountain's peak
pure on high
I am the pure deathless
wealth full of splendour
wise, steeped in immortality
thus was Trishanku's Vedic declaration
he who is chief of metres, of all forms
meaning.hi: जो छन्दों में श्रेष्ठ, विश्वरूप है

meaning.en: may that Indra strengthen me with wisdom
meaning.hi: वह इन्द्र मुझे मेधा से पुष्ट करे

meaning.en: O god, may I be a bearer of the immortal
meaning.hi: हे देव, मैं अमृत का धारक बनूँ

meaning.en: may my body be vigorous
may my tongue be sweetest
may I hear much with my ears
you are the sheath of Brahman
covered by intelligence
guard what I have heard
meaning.hi: मेरे सुने हुए की रक्षा करो

words.sanskrit: dara-eshanayash cha vitta-eshanayash cha loka-eshanayash cha

meaning.en: from craving for wife, for wealth and for worlds
meaning.hi: पत्नी, धन और लोकों की एषणा से

meaning.en: I have risen above
Om bhuh, renounced by me
in low, middle and high tones
meaning.hi: मन्द, मध्य और तार स्वरों में

meaning.en: fearlessness to all beings from me
pulling out the tuft
the sacred thread, supreme purifier
born together with Prajapati in the beginning
meaning.hi: जो आदि में प्रजापति के साथ जन्मा

meaning.en: life-giving and foremost
put on the bright one
may it be strength and splendour
sacred thread, do not dwell outside
enter within, into the centre
Om bhuh, go to the ocean, svaha
meaning.hi: ॐ भूः, समुद्र में जाओ, स्वाहा

meaning.en: I have completed all action
meaning.hi: मैंने सब कर्म पूरे कर लिए

meaning.en: arms raised, he should go north
meaning.hi: भुजाएँ उठाकर उत्तर की ओर जाए

meaning.en: nothing is other than or apart from me
he should leave the body remembering the saving syllable
meaning.hi: तारक का स्मरण करते हुए देह छोड़े

meaning.en: then Narada asked the Grandfather
meaning.hi: तब नारद ने पितामह से पूछा

meaning.en: renunciation is the cessation of all action
meaning.hi: संन्यास सब कर्मों का निवर्तक है

meaning.en: was said by you yourself
again, he should be devoted to his order's conduct
meaning.hi: फिर, अपने आश्रम के आचार में लगा रहे

meaning.en: then the Grandfather said
the states of waking, dream, deep sleep and the fourth
meaning.hi: जाग्रत, स्वप्न, सुषुप्ति और तुरीय अवस्थाएँ

meaning.en: inclined to action, knowledge or detachment
meaning.hi: कर्म, ज्ञान या वैराग्य की ओर प्रवृत्त

meaning.en: with conduct suited to them
how many kinds of renunciation
please tell us truly
in truth renunciation is only one
meaning.hi: सच में संन्यास एक ही है

meaning.en: through ignorance, incapacity and lapse of action
renunciation of detachment, of knowledge and detachment, of action
renounced by force of past merit
meaning.hi: पूर्व पुण्य कर्म के बल से संन्यस्त

meaning.en: turned from the world through scriptural knowledge
regarding it as fit to reject, like vomited food
meaning.hi: उगले अन्न की तरह त्याज्य मानकर

meaning.en: he alone is the renunciate of knowledge
having practised all in order and experienced all
meaning.hi: क्रम से सब अभ्यास और अनुभव करके

meaning.en: through knowledge, detachment and contemplation of his nature
with only the body remaining
he is the renunciate of knowledge and detachment
even without detachment, following the order of stages
meaning.hi: वैराग्य न होने पर भी आश्रम-क्रम से

meaning.en: he is the renunciate of action
renouncing straight from studenthood
then naked from renunciation, is the renunciate of detachment
the knowing renunciate is the renunciate of knowledge
the one seeking to know is the renunciate of action
renunciation of action is also twofold
meaning.hi: कर्म-संन्यास भी दो प्रकार का है

meaning.en: with a cause and without a cause
the one with a cause is the emergency
the one without is renunciation in order
the emergency, with all action lapsed
renunciation at the time the breath departs
meaning.hi: प्राण निकलने के समय का संन्यास

meaning.en: that is renunciation with a cause
being sound of body
that all that is made is perishable
meaning.hi: कि सब बनाया हुआ नाशवान है

meaning.en: the swan dwelling in the bright
the bright one dwelling in the midspace
the priest at the altar, the guest in the house
meaning.hi: वेदी पर होता, घर में अतिथि

meaning.en: the truth, the vast
being certain all other than Brahman is perishable
meaning.hi: ब्रह्म से भिन्न सब नश्वर, यह निश्चय करके

meaning.en: renunciation is of six kinds
the hut-dweller, the many-waters one, the swan, the supreme swan
the one beyond the fourth, and the Avadhuta
keeping tuft and thread, bearing staff and water pot
devoted to worshipping father, mother and teacher
eating in one place
meaning.hi: एक स्थान पर भोजन करने वाला

meaning.en: wearing the white vertical mark, with triple staff
the Bahudaka, with tuft, cloak and three-lined mark
meaning.hi: बहूदक, शिखा, गुदड़ी और त्रिपुण्ड्र वाला

meaning.en: eating eight mouthfuls by the bee's way
meaning.hi: माधुकरी वृत्ति से आठ कौर खाने वाला

meaning.en: the Hamsa with matted hair
eating unplanned bee-gathered food
meaning.hi: बिना योजना की माधुकरी खाने वाला

meaning.en: the Paramahamsa, without tuft or thread
hand as bowl, smeared with ash, renouncing all
the Turiyatita eats like a cow, living on fruit
if he eats cooked food, from three houses
meaning.hi: यदि अन्न खाए तो तीन घरों से

meaning.en: sky-clad, treating his body like a corpse
meaning.hi: दिगम्बर, शरीर को शव जैसा मानने वाला

meaning.en: the Avadhuta has no rules
taking food in the python's way
devoted to contemplating his true nature
if the emergency renunciate lives on
renunciation in the regular order must be done
like the stages from studenthood to the fourth
meaning.hi: ब्रह्मचर्य से तुरीय आश्रम तक के समान

meaning.en: for the three beginning with the Paramahamsa
begging once among all castes
meaning.hi: सब वर्णों में एक बार भिक्षाटन

meaning.en: nakedness is the rule
having studied until he feels it is enough
releasing everything into the water

words.sanskrit: na adhyetavyo na shrotavyam anyat pranavad anyam

meaning.en: nothing to study or hear except Om
meaning.hi: ॐ के सिवा कुछ पढ़ना-सुनना नहीं

words.sanskrit: na tarkam pathen na shabdam api

meaning.en: he should not read logic, not even grammar
meaning.hi: न तर्क पढ़े, न व्याकरण भी

meaning.en: for the ascetic no worship of gods, no festival-watching
meaning.hi: यति के लिए न देव-पूजा, न उत्सव-दर्शन

meaning.en: no round of pilgrimage
the Kutichaka's alms in one place
meaning.hi: कुटीचक की भिक्षा एक स्थान पर

meaning.en: the Hamsa's eight mouthfuls in eight houses
meaning.hi: हंस के आठ घरों में आठ कौर

meaning.en: the Avadhuta's python-way
one who does not know his nature is not senior
meaning.hi: जो स्वरूपज्ञ नहीं वह ज्येष्ठ नहीं

meaning.en: no buying, selling or bartering
for the ascetic nothing is to be done
meaning.hi: यति के लिए कुछ करणीय नहीं

meaning.en: if there is, it is confusion of orders
therefore renunciates are entitled to reflection and so on
meaning.hi: इसलिए संन्यासियों का मनन आदि में अधिकार

meaning.en: for the emergency renunciate and Kutichaka, the earthly world
for the Bahudaka, heaven
for the Hamsa, the world of austerity; for the Paramahamsa, the world of truth
meaning.hi: हंस का तपोलोक, परमहंस का सत्यलोक

meaning.en: absolute freedom in one's own Self
like the maxim of wasp and grub
whatever state one remembers
meaning.hi: जिस-जिस भाव का स्मरण करते हुए

meaning.en: leaves the body at the end
that very state he attains
not otherwise; this is scripture's command
meaning.hi: अन्यथा नहीं, यही श्रुति का शासन है

words.sanskrit: svarupanusandhanam vina anyatha achara-paro na bhavet

meaning.en: apart from contemplating one's nature, one should not be devoted to other conduct
meaning.hi: स्वरूप-चिन्तन के बिना अन्य आचरण में न लगे

meaning.en: for one with knowledge and detachment, liberation is in oneself
meaning.hi: ज्ञान-वैराग्य सम्पन्न की मुक्ति अपने में ही

meaning.en: in waking, Vishva; in dream, Taijasa
meaning.hi: जाग्रत में विश्व, स्वप्न में तैजस

meaning.en: in deep sleep, Prajna
from difference of states, difference of their lords
of the fourteen instruments
the functions are four
mind, intellect, ego and memory
know waking as seated in the eyes
meaning.hi: जाग्रत को नेत्रों में स्थित जानो

meaning.en: dream enters the throat
meaning.hi: स्वप्न कण्ठ में प्रवेश करता है

meaning.en: deep sleep dwells in the heart
the fourth is set in the crown

words.sanskrit: yady apeksha asti tad anurupo bhavati

meaning.en: if there is an inclination, one becomes like it
meaning.hi: यदि अपेक्षा है तो वैसा ही हो जाता है

meaning.en: by study of other sciences
useless like a camel's load of saffron
meaning.hi: ऊँट के केसर-भार की तरह व्यर्थ

meaning.en: no taking up yoga science, no study of Sankhya
meaning.hi: न योगशास्त्र में प्रवृत्ति, न सांख्य का अभ्यास

meaning.en: no dealing in mantras and rites
like ornaments on a corpse
not devoted to chanting Om
meaning.hi: ॐ के जप में लगा नहीं

meaning.en: like the froth of castor oil
meaning.hi: अरण्डी के तेल के झाग की तरह

meaning.en: with hand as bowl, sky-clad
like a servant awaiting orders
meaning.hi: आदेश की प्रतीक्षा करते सेवक के न्याय से

words.sanskrit: bhiksha-matrena jivi syat sa yatir yati-vritti-ha

meaning.en: one who merely lives on alms destroys the ascetic's way
meaning.hi: केवल भिक्षा पर जीने वाला यति-वृत्ति का नाशक है

meaning.en: not by bearing a staff, not by shaving
meaning.hi: न दण्ड धारण से, न मुण्डन से

meaning.en: not by dress nor by showy conduct is liberation
meaning.hi: न वेश से, न दम्भ-आचार से मुक्ति

words.sanskrit: jnana-dando dhrito yena ekadandi sa uchyate

meaning.en: one who holds the staff of knowledge is called single-staffed
meaning.hi: जो ज्ञान-दण्ड धारण करे वही एकदण्डी

meaning.en: one who holds a wooden staff, eats anything, lacks knowledge
he goes to terrible hells called Maharaurava
meaning.hi: वह महारौरव नामक घोर नरकों में जाता है

meaning.en: fame is equal to a sow's dung
meaning.hi: प्रतिष्ठा सूअरी की विष्ठा के समान

meaning.en: declared by the great sages
therefore, giving it up
the ascetic should wander like a worm
unasked, as it comes
let food and covering be
and by another's wish sky-clad
meaning.hi: और दूसरे की इच्छा से दिगम्बर

meaning.en: he should bathe by another's wish
meaning.hi: दूसरे की इच्छा से स्नान करे

meaning.en: one who is disciplined even in dreams
meaning.hi: जो सपने में भी युक्त हो

meaning.en: as in waking, and especially
meaning.hi: जैसे जाग्रत में, विशेष रूप से

meaning.en: one of such conduct is considered best
meaning.hi: ऐसे आचरण वाला श्रेष्ठ माना गया

meaning.en: most excellent among knowers of Brahman
in not getting, let him not be dejected
meaning.hi: न मिलने पर विषादी न हो

meaning.en: and in getting, not elated
meaning.hi: और मिलने पर हर्षित न हो

meaning.en: let him take only enough to sustain life
freed from attachment to sense objects
and gains that come with honour
he should loathe completely
for by honoured gains
even a liberated ascetic is bound
meaning.hi: मुक्त यति भी बँध जाता है

meaning.en: and for sustaining life
when the fires are out and people have eaten
meaning.hi: जब अंगार बुझ गए हों और लोग खा चुके हों

meaning.en: at a proper time, among the people
he should go round houses for alms
meaning.hi: भिक्षा के लिए घरों में घूमे

meaning.en: the yogi going about with his hand as bowl
meaning.hi: हाथ को पात्र बनाकर घूमता योगी

meaning.en: should not beg more than once
meaning.hi: एक से अधिक बार भिक्षा न माँगे

meaning.en: he may eat standing or walking
and likewise sip water in between
holding their bounds like the ocean
meaning.hi: समुद्र की तरह मर्यादा धारण किए

meaning.en: are those of broad and pure heart
they do not abandon their fixed course
the great, like the sun
when with the mouth his food
the sage seeks like a cow
meaning.hi: मुनि गाय की तरह खोजता है

meaning.en: then he is equal toward all
he becomes fit for immortality
meaning.hi: वह अमरता के योग्य होता है

meaning.en: going to a house beyond reproach
but he should avoid a disreputable house
he should enter where the door is open
not go to a house where it is closed
meaning.hi: बन्द द्वार वाले घर न जाए

meaning.en: and covered with dust
sheltering in an empty house
or dwelling at the foot of a tree
meaning.hi: या पेड़ की जड़ में निवास वाला

meaning.en: having given up all likes and dislikes
sleeping wherever the sun sets
meaning.hi: जहाँ सूर्यास्त हो वहीं सोने वाला

meaning.en: without fire, without home
living on whatever is obtained
meaning.hi: जो मिले उसी पर जीने वाला

meaning.en: the sage, restrained, master of the senses
having gone forth and taken to the forest
with knowledge as sacrifice, master of the senses
awaiting his time, just wandering
meaning.hi: काल की प्रतीक्षा करता, बस विचरता

meaning.en: he becomes fit for becoming Brahman
meaning.hi: ब्रह्म होने के योग्य होता है

meaning.en: fearlessness to all beings
the sage who wanders having given
for him, from any beings
fear arises anywhere
without pride and without ego
beyond opposites, doubts cut
he never gets angry, never hates
does not speak falsehood with his voice
and moving among holy places
meaning.hi: और पवित्र स्थानों में विचरने वाला

meaning.en: not harming beings
meaning.hi: प्राणियों को हानि न पहुँचाने वाला

meaning.en: the alms that come when the time arrives
serves for becoming Brahman
meaning.hi: ब्रह्म होने के योग्य बनाती है

meaning.en: with forest-dwellers and householders
he should never associate
he should seek to live unknown
meaning.hi: अज्ञात रहकर जीने की इच्छा करे

meaning.en: and delight should not seize him
meaning.hi: और हर्ष उसमें प्रवेश न करे

meaning.en: the road shown by the sun
he should roam the earth like a small creature
meaning.hi: कीट की तरह पृथ्वी पर विचरे

meaning.en: actions joined with desire for reward
and those joined with harm
those joined with maintaining world order
he should neither do nor cause to be done
he should not cling to false teachings
meaning.hi: असत् शास्त्रों में आसक्त न हो

meaning.en: should not live by a trade
should give up wrangling and arguments
should take no side
meaning.hi: किसी पक्ष का आश्रय न ले

meaning.en: he should not bind disciples to himself
nor study many books
should not engage in exposition
nor begin any undertakings anywhere
meaning.hi: कहीं कोई उद्यम शुरू न करे

meaning.en: with unmanifest sign and unmanifest purpose
meaning.hi: अव्यक्त चिह्न और अव्यक्त उद्देश्य वाला

meaning.en: the sage like a madman or child
the seer, like a mute, himself
meaning.hi: कवि, गूँगे की तरह, स्वयं को

meaning.en: should show to people in that light
meaning.hi: लोगों को उसी रूप में दिखाए

meaning.en: he should not do or say anything
meaning.hi: न कुछ करे, न कुछ कहे

meaning.en: nor dwell on good or bad
delighting in the Self, by this way of life
meaning.hi: आत्मा में रमता, इस वृत्ति से

meaning.en: the sage should wander like one who is dull
alone he should wander this earth
unattached, with senses restrained
playing in the Self, delighting in the Self
meaning.hi: आत्मा में क्रीड़ा, आत्मा में रति

meaning.en: self-possessed, seeing all as equal
the wise should play like a child
the skilful should move like a dullard
the learned should speak like a madman
the Veda-knower should live the cow's way
meaning.hi: वेदज्ञ गाय की रीति से जिए

meaning.en: mocked and insulted by the wicked
deceived or envied
meaning.hi: ठगा गया या जिससे ईर्ष्या की गई

meaning.en: beaten or confined
meaning.hi: पीटा गया या बन्दी बनाया गया

meaning.en: or deprived of his livelihood
defiled or urinated on by the ignorant
meaning.hi: अज्ञानियों द्वारा थूका या मूत्र किया गया

meaning.en: shaken in many such ways
meaning.hi: इस प्रकार अनेक ढंग से झकझोरा गया

meaning.en: desiring the true good, in hardship
meaning.hi: श्रेय चाहने वाला, कष्ट में पड़ा

meaning.en: he should lift himself by himself
honour, the greatest loss
it causes to the growth of yoga, because
meaning.hi: क्योंकि यह योग की बढ़त को करता है

meaning.en: the yogi disregarded by people
attains the perfection of yoga
so the yogi should behave
not defiling the dharma of the good
meaning.hi: सज्जनों के धर्म को दूषित न करते हुए

meaning.en: that people would think little of him
and would not seek his company
of the womb-born, egg-born and the rest
by speech, mind, body and action
meaning.hi: वाणी, मन, शरीर और कर्म से

meaning.en: the disciplined should do no injury
and should avoid all attachments
desire and anger, likewise
arrogance, greed, delusion and the rest
meaning.hi: दर्प, लोभ, मोह आदि जो हैं

meaning.en: casting off those faults
the wanderer is free of fear
eating alms and silence
austerity and, especially, meditation
meaning.hi: तप और विशेष रूप से ध्यान

meaning.en: right knowledge and detachment
this is held as the mendicant's dharma
meaning.hi: यह भिक्षु का धर्म माना गया है

meaning.en: always wearing ochre
devoted to the discipline of meditation
at the village edge or the foot of a tree
meaning.hi: गाँव के छोर पर या पेड़ की जड़ में

meaning.en: he may live even in a temple
he should always live by alms
never eat food from a single person
meaning.hi: कभी एक ही का अन्न न खाए

meaning.en: until purity of mind arises
for that long the wise should always wander
then, having gone forth with a pure self
he may move about anywhere
outside and inside, everywhere
seeing Janardana
the silent one should wander everywhere
like the wind, free of stain
the same in sorrow and joy, patient
and eat what comes to his hand
without enmity, seeing equally
in Brahmins, cows, horses, deer and others
meaning.hi: ब्राह्मण, गाय, घोड़े, हिरण आदि में

meaning.en: contemplating Vishnu in the mind
meaning.hi: मन से विष्णु का चिन्तन करता हुआ

meaning.en: the supreme Self, the Lord
made of pure awareness, supreme bliss
remembering 'I am Brahman alone'
meaning.hi: मैं ब्रह्म ही हूँ, यह स्मरण करते हुए

meaning.en: holding the mind as his staff
meaning.hi: मन को दण्ड बनाकर धारण करके

meaning.en: turned from hope, wearing the directions as clothing
meaning.hi: आशा से निवृत्त, दिशाओं को वस्त्र बनाकर

meaning.en: facing away from the world of appearances
by the wasp and grub maxim, he becomes free
meaning.hi: भ्रमर-कीट न्याय से मुक्त होता है

meaning.en: by the force of that practice
like the maxim of the wasp and the grub
truthful speech
marked out by knowledge and detachment
should live with only the body remaining
meaning.hi: केवल शरीर शेष रहते हुए रहे

meaning.en: knowledge is his body
detachment is his life breath
calm and restraint are his two eyes
meaning.hi: शान्ति और दान्ति उसकी दो आँखें

meaning.en: like pillars sunk in mud
meaning.hi: कीचड़ में गड़े खम्भों के समान

meaning.en: like a helmsman, like a driver with an elephant
meaning.hi: कर्णधार की तरह, हाथी के महावत की तरह

meaning.en: made and perishable
should live as 'I am Brahman'
meaning.hi: 'मैं ब्रह्म हूँ' इस भाव से व्यवहार करे

meaning.en: should live as one freed while alive
one who has done all that was to be done
meaning.hi: जिसने करने योग्य सब कर लिया

meaning.en: not with the thought 'I am not Brahman'
meaning.hi: 'मैं ब्रह्म नहीं हूँ' इस भाव से नहीं

meaning.en: 'I am Brahman', without a break
in waking, dream and deep sleep
having reached the fourth state
should go beyond the fourth
waking by day, dream by night
meaning.hi: दिन में जाग्रत, रात में स्वप्न

meaning.en: deep sleep at midnight
the working of the fourteen organs
form, sound, taste, smell, touch
the understanding that grasps objects
meaning.hi: विषयों को ग्रहण करने वाली बुद्धि

meaning.en: by the intellect he comes to know
by the thinking faculty he becomes aware
by the ego he makes things 'mine'
by identifying with the body he becomes a limited self
meaning.hi: देह के अभिमान से जीव बनता है

meaning.en: like a householder who owns his house
meaning.hi: घर के अभिमान वाले गृहस्थ की तरह

meaning.en: in the eastern petal, a turn to merit
sleep and sloth
detachment in the centre of the lotus
reflection on the Self in the filaments
free of all four, beyond the fourth
waking self, dreaming self, sleeping self, neutral witness
the one God, witness, without qualities
should declare 'that Brahman am I'
if not so
but not so for what is beyond the fourth
meaning.hi: पर तुरीयातीत के लिए ऐसा नहीं

meaning.en: through gross, subtle and causal forms
meaning.hi: स्थूल, सूक्ष्म और कारण रूपों से

meaning.en: the witness alone remains one
meaning.hi: साक्षी ही एक बना रहता है

meaning.en: the neutral one as seer
the sense of doing and of enjoying
the living self is touched; what is other is not
meaning.hi: जीव छुआ जाता है; अन्य नहीं छुआ जाता

meaning.en: if you say so, no
from taking oneself as a living self comes the claim on the body-field
meaning.hi: जीव के अभिमान से क्षेत्र का अभिमान

meaning.en: from claiming the body comes being a living self
like the space in a pot and the great space
exists through a partition
the swan, with the mantra 'I am He'
breathing in and breathing out
should give up taking the body as oneself
attachment dropped, anger conquered, eating lightly
meaning.hi: आसक्ति छोड़ी, क्रोध जीता, हल्का आहार

meaning.en: closing the doors with the understanding
should settle the mind in meditation
in empty places
in caves and in forests
the yogi always joined in practice
should properly begin meditation
at feasts for guests, ancestor rites and sacrifices
at temple processions and festivals
among great crowds
the knower of yoga seeking fulfilment
should never go
so that people think little of him
meaning.hi: ऐसे कि लोग उसे तुच्छ समझें

meaning.en: and treat him with scorn
if he is a yogi truly established
meaning.hi: यदि वह सचमुच युक्त योगी है

meaning.en: should not defile the path of the good
meaning.hi: सज्जनों के मार्ग को दूषित न करे

meaning.en: the rod of speech, restraint of speech
meaning.hi: वाणी का दण्ड, वाणी पर संयम

meaning.en: the rod of action
the rod of mind
the rods held firmly in check
bearer of the triple staff, a great renunciate
when the smoke has cleared and the fire died down
meaning.hi: धुआँ छँटने और आग शान्त होने पर

meaning.en: should go for alms in the bee's way
at the homes of the leading Brahmins
the renunciate held to be the highest
carrying the staff and begging
in his own duty, without real zeal
meaning.hi: अपने धर्म में, बिना लगन के

meaning.en: does not reach detachment
a low sort of renunciate
in a house where especially
meaning.hi: जिस घर में विशेष रूप से

meaning.en: he gets alms and, from liking, craves it
meaning.hi: भिक्षा पाता है और वासना से चाहता है

meaning.en: who does not go there again
he is a renunciate; no other is counted one
meaning.hi: वही यति है; दूसरा नहीं माना जाता

meaning.en: free of body, senses and the rest
the witness of all
knowledge that is ultimately real
whose nature is joy
shining by its own light
knows the supreme reality
becomes one beyond caste and stage of life
meaning.hi: वर्ण और आश्रम से परे हो जाए

meaning.en: caste, stage of life and the rest, on the body
laid on by illusion
not of the Self whose nature is awareness
with the na before it: they are never mine
meaning.hi: पहले के न के साथ: वे कभी मेरे नहीं

meaning.en: he who knows this through the Upanishads
meaning.hi: जो वेदान्तों से यह जानता है

meaning.en: he becomes one beyond caste and stage of life
meaning.hi: वह वर्णाश्रम से परे हो जाए

meaning.en: the conduct of caste and stage has slipped away
through seeing his own Self
having passed beyond all castes and stages
meaning.hi: सब वर्णों और आश्रमों को पार करके

meaning.en: rests in his own Self
having gone past his own stages and castes
meaning.hi: अपने आश्रमों और वर्णों को लाँघकर

meaning.en: the man who rests in the Self alone
is called one beyond caste and stage
by those who know the meaning of all the Vedas
meaning.hi: सब वेदों का अर्थ जानने वालों द्वारा

meaning.en: castes and stages too belong to something else
meaning.hi: वर्ण और आश्रम भी अन्य में स्थित

meaning.en: all laid upon the Self
through confusion
by that one who has not known the Self
meaning.hi: उस आत्मा को न जानने वाले द्वारा

meaning.en: no command, no prohibition
reckoning of what to avoid and what not
for those who have known Brahman
nor anything else
turning away in detachment from all beings
even up to the rank of Brahma
meaning.hi: ब्रह्मा के पद तक से भी

meaning.en: cutting through clinging fondness
even toward sons, friends and the rest
meaning.hi: पुत्र, मित्र आदि के प्रति भी

meaning.en: full of trust in the paths to freedom
longing for the knowledge of the Upanishads
with a gift in his hands
should go to a teacher who knows Brahman
pleasing him with acts of service
for a long time, with a settled mind
the meaning of the Upanishadic sayings
should listen with full attention
free of 'mine', free of ego
rid of every attachment
endowed with calm and the rest
sees the Self in himself
meaning.hi: अपने में आत्मा को देखता है

meaning.en: only by seeing the flaws of worldly existence
meaning.hi: केवल संसार के दोष देखने से

meaning.en: detachment is always born
for one detached from the round of worldly life
renunciation will follow, no doubt
the seeker of freedom named paramahamsa
the one direct means to liberation
should cultivate the knowledge of Brahman
through hearing the Upanishads and the rest
to gain the knowledge of Brahman
the one called paramahamsa
with calm, restraint and the rest
should be equipped with all the means
devoted to the study of the Upanishads
calm, restrained, master of the senses
fearless, free of 'mine', steady
untouched by opposites, owning nothing
wearing a worn-out loincloth
shaven-headed, or even naked
wise, knowing the Upanishads, a yogi
without 'mine', without pride of self
even-minded toward friends and the rest
kind to every living creature
alone, possessed of knowledge, at perfect peace
he crosses over, no other
meaning.hi: वह पार उतरता है, दूसरा नहीं

meaning.en: intent on the good of his teachers
should stay there a year
watchful in the personal observances
and always so in the moral restraints
having gained at the end
the unsurpassed yoga of knowledge
never going against what is right
should roam this earth
at the close of the year
the unsurpassed yoga of knowledge
letting go of the three stages of life
and arrived at the highest stage
taking leave of the teachers
should indeed wander this earth
attachment given up, anger mastered
eating little, senses subdued
these two cut a sorry figure
by acting against their calling
the householder who undertakes nothing
the mendicant busy with affairs
is intoxicated on seeing an alluring woman
meaning.hi: मोहक स्त्री को देखकर मतवाला होता है

meaning.en: and is intoxicated on drinking liquor
meaning.hi: और मदिरा पीकर मतवाला होता है

meaning.en: woman whose glance is poison
meaning.hi: जिसकी दृष्टि विष है, ऐसी स्त्री

meaning.en: should keep far away
talking with women
idle chatter, gazing
dancing, singing, joking
and should avoid speaking ill of others
no ritual bath, no prayer repetition, no worship
meaning.hi: न स्नान, न जप, न पूजा

meaning.en: no fire offering, not even spiritual exercise
no tending of the sacred fire or the like
none of this is his here
no image worship, no rite for the ancestors
pilgrimage and vows
no merit and demerit and the rest
no rule, no worldly task
should give up all rites and actions
and the customs of the world entirely
worms, insects and moths
and likewise, the yogi, plants
meaning.hi: और वैसे ही योगी, वनस्पतियों को

meaning.en: the wise one should not destroy while living
the renunciate whose mind is on the highest truth
meaning.hi: परम सत्य में मन वाला संन्यासी

meaning.en: always turned inward, clear
at rest, his understanding complete in itself
meaning.hi: प्रशान्त, स्वयं में पूर्ण बुद्धि वाला

meaning.en: letting go of inner attachment
wander in the world, Narada
not in a land without a king
meaning.hi: बिना राजा वाले देश में नहीं

meaning.en: the sage who travels alone wanders
meaning.hi: अकेला विचरने वाला मुनि विचरता है

meaning.en: wanting no praise, bowing to no one
uttering no offering-call to the ancestors
with a dwelling that moves and stays
the renunciate should live on what chance brings
what is the rule of life for a renunciate
keeping to one place during the rains
wandering alone for eight months
like a frightened deer
gathering food in the bee's way
meaning.hi: भौंरे की वृत्ति से आहार लेते हुए

meaning.en: should shun ghee as if it were blood
meaning.hi: घी को रक्त की तरह त्यागे

meaning.en: like a thief set free from prison
meaning.hi: कारागार से छूटे चोर की तरह

meaning.en: living on what comes without effort
meaning.hi: बिना प्रयत्न के मिला खाते हुए

meaning.en: given to meditation on Brahman and Om
meaning.hi: ब्रह्म और प्रणव के ध्यान में लगा

meaning.en: beyond the three qualities, free of the six waves
one night in a village, five in a town
meaning.hi: गाँव में एक रात, कस्बे में पाँच

meaning.en: should live alone in mountain caves
three make a village, four a city
meaning.hi: तीन से गाँव, चार से नगर

meaning.en: no room for the fourteen organs
the wealth of detachment from unbroken knowledge
meaning.hi: अखण्ड ज्ञान से वैराग्य की सम्पदा

words.sanskrit: matto na kashchin na anyo vyatiriktah

meaning.en: no one apart from me, nothing other
meaning.hi: मुझसे अलग कोई नहीं, कुछ भिन्न नहीं

meaning.en: until the glimmer of past karma fades
meaning.hi: प्रारब्ध के आभास के नाश तक

meaning.en: bathing three times a day for the hut-dweller
a bath of the mind for the supreme swan
a bath of wind for the avadhuta
shaving once a season for the hut-dweller
shaving once at each turning of the sun
food from one house for the hut-dweller
meaning.hi: कुटीचक का एक घर का अन्न

meaning.en: the hand as bowl
eating like a cow for the one beyond the fourth
the python's way for the avadhuta
two cloths for the hut-dweller
clothed in the directions, or one loincloth
going as one was born
a deerskin for the swan and supreme swan
meaning.hi: हंस और परमहंस के लिए मृगचर्म

meaning.en: worship of gods, worship in the mind
dwelling on 'I am He'
fitness for repeating mantras
fitness for meditation
fit for nothing else of that kind
fitness to teach the great sayings
not fit to instruct others
meaning.hi: दूसरों को उपदेश का अधिकार नहीं

meaning.en: the spoken Om, the inner Om
the Om that is Brahman
listening, reflection, deep contemplation
remembering Om, the ferry across worldly life
meaning.hi: संसार से तारने वाले तारक का स्मरण करते हुए

meaning.en: should search out the way to final freedom
the blessed Supreme Lord
that which carries one across worldly life
meaning.hi: संसार से पार ले जाने वाला

meaning.en: be gracious and tell
Om is Brahman
as in the individual and in the whole
meaning.hi: व्यष्टि और समष्टि के ढंग से

meaning.en: the Om of dissolution, the Om of creation
because it is inner, outer and both
meaning.hi: भीतरी, बाहरी और उभयात्मक होने से

meaning.en: the Om of everyday use
the Om of the seers, the Om of the cosmic form
the Om of the half-measure
is divided into eight
the sounds A, U and M
the half-measure, the resonance, the point
the digit and the power
made of ten thousand parts
having parts without end
the cosmic Om has qualities
the Om of dissolution is without qualities
the Om of arising is of both natures
drawn out long, prolonged
made of sixteen measures
beyond the thirty-six principles
beyond the digit, peace, beyond peace
the mind-transcending and beyond it
the middle, seeing and supreme levels of speech
the twofold nature of matter and spirit
the support of all, the supreme light
holding the ground of the whole world
meaning.hi: पूरे प्रपंच की नींव धारण किए

meaning.en: made of every letter, it is Time
made of every sacred teaching, it is Shiva
the highest of all scriptures
to be sought, tracked down
the substance of all the Upanishads
what has been, what is, what will be
spoken of in the three times, yet undecaying
meaning.hi: तीनों कालों में उदित, फिर भी अविनाशी

meaning.en: know it to be this very Om
the giver of freedom
that very Self
described by the word Brahman
one, deathless, ageless
having directly experienced
seeing it as wearing the body
becoming one with it
that Self with three bodies
be certain it is the supreme Brahman
should dwell on the supreme Brahman
the order of the waking self and the rest, step by step
meaning.hi: विश्व आदि का क्रम, क्रम से

meaning.en: being gross and feeding on the gross
meaning.hi: स्थूल होने और स्थूल भोगने से

meaning.en: being subtle, feeding on the subtle
because it enjoys the bliss of oneness
meaning.hi: एकत्व के आनन्द के भोग से

meaning.en: this Self is fourfold
meaning.hi: यह आत्मा चार प्रकार का है

meaning.en: having four quarters
the waking one, gross, knowing the gross
enjoying all the world
nineteen-mouthed
eight-limbed, all-pervading, the lord
enjoyer of the gross, fourfold
Vishva, Vaishvanara, the Person
the world-conqueror, the first quarter
the lord gone into the place of dream
whose awareness is of subtle things
one and no other
O scorcher of foes
enjoyer of the subtle
the shining one, the dreaming self
ruler of beings
the Golden Womb
is called the second quarter

words.sanskrit: yatra supto na kanchana kamam kamayate

meaning.en: where the sleeper longs for nothing
meaning.hi: जहाँ सोया हुआ कुछ भी नहीं चाहता

meaning.en: sees no dream
that is deep sleep
plainly, clearly
gathered into one, resting in deep sleep
a single mass of awareness
at ease, happy
made of unending bliss
dwelling within every living being
taster of bliss
with awareness as its doorway
all-pervading and unchanging
fourfold, the Lord, the knower
called the third quarter
this is the Lord of all
this is the all-knowing
this is the inner guide
this is the womb of everything
the coming forth and the return
all three of these states of beings
standing in the way of final stillness
that deep sleep and that dream
declared to be mere illusion
the fourth, though fourfold too
of one flavour, being and awareness
because the fourth comes to rest in it
meaning.hi: तुरीय के उसमें विश्राम पाने से

meaning.en: following the oneness of each
meaning.hi: हर एक की एकता के अनुसार

meaning.en: the knower, the one who assents, the one beyond assent
means of knowing through distinction
here too three distinctions
deep sleep, dream, the inner
knowing it to be mere illusion
this is of one flavour, being and awareness
meaning.hi: यह सत्-चित् का एक रस है

meaning.en: this teaching sets it apart
not what knows the gross day after day
meaning.hi: दिन-प्रतिदिन स्थूल को जानने वाला नहीं

meaning.en: not at all what knows the subtle
not a knower, nowhere, O sage
meaning.hi: न प्रज्ञ, कहीं नहीं, हे मुनि

meaning.en: not unknowing
not knowing in both directions
not knowing turned within
not a mass of knowing, unseen
without marks, ungraspable
unthinkable, unnameable
whose essence is the certainty of the one Self
meaning.hi: एक आत्मा के निश्चय का सार

meaning.en: where the world falls still, auspicious, peaceful, non-dual
like the sun everywhere
the self-shining space of Brahman
what is the nature of Brahman
he is one and I am another
meaning.hi: वह अन्य है, मैं अन्य हूँ

meaning.en: they are like beasts, not beasts by birth
meaning.hi: वे पशु हैं, स्वभाव से पशु नहीं

meaning.en: is set free from the jaws of death
meaning.hi: मृत्यु के मुख से छूटता है

meaning.en: there is no other road for the journey
meaning.hi: जाने के लिए दूसरा मार्ग नहीं

meaning.en: time, inborn nature, necessity, chance
the elements, the womb, the Person
these are to be considered
nor is it their combination
the self has no power over the cause of pleasure and pain
meaning.hi: आत्मा सुख-दुःख के कारण पर वशहीन है

meaning.en: those who followed the path of meditation
the power that is God's own self
hidden within its own qualities
all those causes
the One who alone governs
one rim with three bands
sixteen tips, fifty spokes
with twenty counter-spokes
one cord of every form
one delusion born of two causes
whose waters are the five streams
whose waves are the five breaths
with five whirlpools
rushing with a flood of five sorrows
meaning.hi: पाँच दुःखों की बाढ़ के वेग वाली

meaning.en: fifty branches, five stages
we think of it, we study it
in the vast wheel where all live and rest
meaning.hi: सबके जीवन और आश्रय वाले विशाल में

meaning.en: the swan goes round in the wheel of Brahman
thinking itself separate from the mover
meaning.hi: अपने को और प्रेरक को अलग मानकर

meaning.en: then, blessed by Him
reaches deathlessness
this is praised in song as the supreme Brahman
meaning.hi: यही परम ब्रह्म के रूप में गाया गया

meaning.en: in it the threefold world
the firm foundation and the imperishable
knowers of the Veda, knowing what lies within
melted into the supreme Brahman, devoted to it
meaning.hi: परम ब्रह्म में लीन, उसी के परायण

meaning.en: the perishable and imperishable woven together
the Lord bears the manifest and unmanifest universe
meaning.hi: ईश व्यक्त-अव्यक्त विश्व को सँभालता है

meaning.en: and the self, not being lord
is bound by taking itself as enjoyer
knowing God, freed from every fetter
meaning.hi: देव को जानकर सब पाशों से मुक्त

meaning.en: two unborn: the knowing and the unknowing
the ruler and the ruled
one unborn nature, bound up with enjoyer and enjoyed
meaning.hi: भोक्ता और भोग्य से जुड़ी एक अजा

words.sanskrit: anantash cha atma vishvarupo hy akarta

meaning.en: the Self endless, of every form, doing nothing
when one finds these three
meaning.hi: जब इन तीनों को पाता है

meaning.en: primal matter is what perishes
the deathless imperishable is Hara
the one God rules the perishable and the self
meaning.hi: एक देव क्षर और आत्मा पर शासन करता है

meaning.en: by meditating, joining, becoming His reality
at the end the world's illusion falls away
knowing God, freed from every fetter
meaning.hi: देव को जानकर सब बन्धनों से मुक्त

meaning.en: with the afflictions worn away
the end of birth and death
at the parting from the body, a third state, lordship over the universe
meaning.hi: देह छूटने पर तीसरी दशा, विश्व-ऐश्वर्य

meaning.en: alone, every desire fulfilled
this is to be known, forever dwelling in the Self
meaning.hi: यही ज्ञेय है, सदा आत्मा में स्थित

meaning.en: beyond it nothing more to know
the enjoyer, the enjoyed, the mover
all has been said: threefold Brahman
knowledge of the Self, rooted in austerity
the highest Upanishad of Brahman
dwelling continually on his true nature
meaning.hi: अपने स्वरूप का निरन्तर चिन्तन करते हुए

meaning.en: where is delusion, where is grief
for one who sees oneness
whose true nature does not perish
finer than the finest, greater than the greatest
meaning.hi: सूक्ष्म से सूक्ष्म, महान से महान

meaning.en: hidden in the heart
the one free from craving, his sorrow gone, sees
through the clarity the creator gives
without hands or feet, swift and grasping
sees without eyes
hears without ears
yet no one knows Him
the first, the great Person
bodiless within bodies
steady within the unsteady
the Self, vast and all-pervading
the wise one does not grieve
the upholder of all
whose power cannot be imagined
known through the special meaning at the end of all scriptures
meaning.hi: सब आगमों के अन्त के विशेष अर्थ से ज्ञेय

meaning.en: higher than the highest
at the close of all, to be known once
meaning.hi: सबके अन्त में एक बार जानने योग्य

meaning.en: the seer, the ancient one
highest of the highest beings
worshipped by all the gods
without beginning, middle or end, endless, unchanging
the ground that holds up Shiva, Vishnu and lotus-born Brahma
meaning.hi: शिव, विष्णु और कमलजन्मा ब्रह्मा का आधार

meaning.en: this whole manifest world covered by Himself
meaning.hi: यह सारा प्रपंच उसी से ढका

meaning.en: fivefold, living in the five
the endless round of births from the fivefold mixing
not covered by His own parts
made of His own radiance, eternal, auspicious
not one who has not turned from wrongdoing
meaning.hi: जो दुराचार से नहीं रुका, वह नहीं

meaning.en: not the restless, not the uncollected
not one whose mind is not calm
cannot reach Him, even by knowledge
meaning.hi: ज्ञान से भी उसे नहीं पा सकता

meaning.en: not conscious inwardly, not outwardly
beyond grasping and all dealings
resting within, simply oneself
he is set free
the wanderer who knows his own nature
like a startled deer
meaning.hi: डर से चौंके हिरण की तरह

meaning.en: puts no check on his wandering
letting go of everything but his own body
meaning.hi: अपने शरीर के सिवा सब छोड़कर

meaning.en: living in the way of the bee
seeing all as not other than himself
is set free within himself
meaning.hi: अपने में ही मुक्त हो जाता है

meaning.en: having laid down every action and means of action
meaning.hi: सब क्रियाओं और कारकों से निवृत्त

meaning.en: free of teacher, pupil, scripture and the rest
meaning.hi: गुरु, शिष्य, शास्त्र आदि से मुक्त

meaning.en: how is the penniless one happy and rich
beyond knowing and not knowing
meaning.hi: ज्ञान और अज्ञान दोनों से परे

meaning.en: 'He am I'
that highest home of Vishnu
reaching which yogis do not come back

words.sanskrit: suryo na tatra bhati na shashanko'pi

meaning.en: the sun does not shine there, nor the moon
meaning.hi: वहाँ न सूर्य चमकता है, न चन्द्रमा

meaning.en: he does not return again
that is final freedom
